Electric Ireland, the retail division of ESB, is Ireland’s leading energy provider, supplying electricity, gas and energy services to more than 1.3 million households and businesses on the island of Ireland. Electric Ireland is undertaking a transforma

city, gas and energy services to more than 1.3 million households and businesses on the island of Ireland. Electric Ireland is undertaking a transformation programme involving the migration of customers from existing systems to a new cloud-based operating platform and updated customer care operating model. Customer migration will occur in structured waves, during which legacy business-as-usual operations and the new operating model will operate in parallel. This procurement is intended to appoint Service Provider(s) to support Electric Ireland during this transition and to provide scalable customer care support services in line with business requirements. A.1.1 General Description of the Proposed Contract The Contracting Entity intends to establish a framework agreement for the provision of Electric Ireland Customer Care Support Services to support Electric Ireland’s operating model transformation programme. The Contracting Entity intends to appoint one Service Provider for each Lot. The Contracting Entity intends to award Lot 1 and Lot 2 to different Tenderers and, accordingly, no Tenderer will be awarded both Lots. Tenderers must clearly identify the Lot for which they are submitting a Tender. The procurement is structured across two Lots: Lot 1 – Rapid Mobilisation and Migration Support

mited to: • handling customer interactions; • account management and maintenance of customer records; • billing and payment-related queries and support; • complaint management and resolution; • management of early-stage debt activities; • sales-through-service activities; and • general customer service and support activities. The Postbox is an online submission facility which allows buyers to receive responses from suppliers electronically in a secure environment. Responses are submitted through the portal and held in the secure Postbox until the deadline for responses has expired. Nominated members of the buyer organisation then unlock the Postbox to access the submissions. The Postbox can be used for the receipt of PQQs, tender responses, Quick Quote submissions and all supporting documents. A full audit trail is kept of all access to the Postbox and a complete record of all supplier submissions is stored. Please note: Before you can use the postbox you must record your interest in a notice. The Postbox is an online submission facility which allows buyers to receive responses from suppliers electronically in a secure environment. Responses are submitted through the portal and held in the secure Postbox until the deadline for responses has expired. Nominated members of the buyer organisation then unlock the Postbox to access the submissions. The Postbox can be used for the receipt of PQQs, tender responses, Quick Quote submissions and all supporting documents. A full audit trail is kept of all access to the Postbox and a complete record of all supplier submissions is stored. Please note: Before you can use the postbox you must record your interest in a notice. In the case of a Quick Quote or the second stage of a dual stage procedure you must have been invited by the buyer to submit a response. Postbox Response Workspace All postbox re

Suppliers must provide a managed service offering including implementation, configuration, training, support, service management, and documented service levels. BEING PROCURED NAME OF CONTRACT AND SUMMARY OF SERVICES/GOODS REQUIRED/SUMMARY OF REQUIREMENTS This is a call to competition by IÉ for the procurement of an Internal Communications Platform (the “Contract”). Iarnród Éireann (IÉ) seeks an established and proven high availability mobile-first internal communications platform, delivered as a fully managed SaaS service, to support a geographically dispersed workforce of approximately 5,200–8,000 employees. The solution must be cloud-hosted within the EEA/UK, integrate with Microsoft 365 and enterprise identity systems, support secure authentication, and comply with applicable Irish and EU legislative and regulatory requirements, including data protection, AI, privacy and information security obligations. Suppliers must demonstrate experience delivering, operating, and supporting similar employee communications platforms at comparable scale, including implementation, integration, training, ongoing support, and service management. The solution should support effective employee communications, engagement, audience targeting, and a consistent branded user experience across mobile and web channels. This procurement will establish a long-term contract for the provision, configuration, operation, maintenance, and support of the platform. Su

ience delivering, operating, and supporting similar employee communications platforms at comparable scale, including implementation, integration, training, ongoing support, and service management. The solution should support effective employee communications, engagement, audience targeting, and a consistent branded user experience across mobile and web channels. This procurement will establish a long-term contract for the provision, configuration, operation, maintenance, and support of the platform. Suppliers must provide a managed service offering including implementation, configuration, training, support, service management, and documented service levels. In summary, core requirements include: The platform shall be a high availability SaaS solution with cloud-based storage, supported and hosted within the EEA/ UK, compliant with the GDPR, the Irish Data Protection Acts 1988 to 2018 and CIÉ IT policies, with supplier security standards aligned to ISO 27001 and the NIST Cybersecurity Framework & AI Act and other relevant regulations The platform should provide a consistent user experience across both mobile and web channels for c.5-8k employees and support equitable access to organisational communications, content and functionality for all users regardless of employee location or device.
